definitions.explanation: Something a person is skilled at or naturally good at. Often used in the expression {得手不得手|えてふえて} (strengths and weaknesses).

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{得手|えて}だ。
⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦それぞれ→それぞれ：01453_sorezore⟧{得手不得手|えてふえて}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Everyone has their strengths and weaknesses.

examples.japanese: {得手|えて}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{分野|ぶんや}→分野：03612_bunya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発揮|はっき}する→発揮する：17267_hakkisuru⟧。
examples.english: Show what you can do in the field you are good at.

notes:
Mostly used in set phrases; in everyday speech ⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧ is the usual word.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {得手不得手|えてふえて}: strengths and weaknesses
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{得手|えて}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be good at ~
- {得手|えて}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{帆|ほ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: to seize the chance to do what one is good at (proverb)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧: good at — the everyday word; {得手|えて} is more bookish
- ⟦{不得手|ふえて}→不得手：09989_fuete⟧: weak point — the opposite of {得手|えて}
- ⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧: bad at; dislike — the everyday opposite of ⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧
